Exact rational tests enumerate all mappings through n=7 and all majorization-comparable partition profiles through n=10; the infinite theorem relies on the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The full convex-order extremal hierarchy governs every convex measure of fluctuations of one-cycles of a random functional graph under prescribed indegrees. The exact transfer explains the mechanism, unlike a mere variance computation. First-order orthogonality to all degree functions but nonindependence, and the signed second-order occupancy response, give a natural diagnostic of the dependence between cycles and the degree histogram. This answers a motivated structural question for random mappings and retains meaning independent of further applications.
